p1: A rich man named Nabal had many sheep. David’s men had kept his shepherds safe, like a wall around them. So David asked for some food.
But Nabal said unkind words and gave nothing. David got very angry and set out with his men.
Nabal’s wife, Abigail, was wise and kind. She quickly packed bread, raisins, and fig cakes. Then she rode a donkey to meet David.
p2: Abigail bowed low and said, “Please forgive me.” Her gentle words helped David calm down. He said, “Bless the Lord for sending you to meet me!” Abigail was a peacemaker. She kept a fight from starting.
Jesus said peacemakers are children of Heavenly Father. Tonight, practice saying one gentle word, just like Abigail.
old: There was a rich, mean man named Nabal. David and his men had been kind to Nabal’s workers. So David asked Nabal politely for some food.
But Nabal said meanly, “Who is David? I won’t give him anything!” David got SO angry. He gathered his men to fight Nabal!
Nabal’s wife Abigail was wise and kind. When she heard, she quickly packed lots of food. She rode out to meet David herself!
Abigail bowed down and said, “Please forgive my husband. Don’t do something you’ll regret!” David thanked God for sending wise Abigail. Her kind words stopped a big fight!
